title: Three-Fold Composition of Linear Functions
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Write a simplified formula for the three-fold composition (f o g o h)(x), given f(x) = x + 1, g(x) = 3x, and h(x) = 4 - x.

steps.title: Unpack the Definition of Three-Fold Composition
steps.explanation: By definition, applying f o g o h to x means evaluating h(x) first, applying g to the result, and finally applying f.
steps.why: Function composition is associative and evaluates from right to left.

steps.title: Compose the Inner Two Functions g and h
steps.explanation: Substitute h(x) = 4 - x in place of x in g(x) = 3x and distribute the factor of 3.
steps.why: Replacing the argument of g with h(x) yields the intermediate composite function g o h.

steps.title: Apply the Outer Function f
steps.explanation: Substitute g(h(x)) = 12 - 3x into f(x) = x + 1 and combine constant terms to obtain 13 - 3x.
steps.why: Adding 1 completes the outermost evaluation in f(g(h(x))).
